chalk drawing.constraints: Sketch it in dry chalk: rough, broken strokes with a grainy, powdery texture, the side of the stick dragged across for the fills, and edges that are slightly smudged and feathered. Outline and highlight in chalky white, and fill and hatch every shape in soft pastel chalk tints of the brand colors below. Never use black, never mass in a dark shape, and never fill an area with smooth, flat digital color, a gradient or a glossy highlight. Leave the background completely empty and transparent behind, around and beneath the subject: no backdrop, no surface, no floor, no ground shadow, no soft glow, no vignette, no frame and no border, so the whole drawing lifts off the page in one piece. Keep it to a few large, simple objects drawn with bold, confident strokes, never a heap of small pieces. Draw any animal as a friendly, rounded creature in the same chalk strokes, its natural coloring softened to pastel chalk.
